```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(qs)
library(scCustomize)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
source("Heatmap.R")
Cultured_seu <- qread("../data/Cultured_fibroblasts_aucell.qs")

setwd(".")

save.path <- "../results/Supplementary_Fig_5_figures"
if (!dir.exists(save.path)) {
  dir.create(save.path, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

## Supplymentary Fig 5a
```{r, fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 7.5}
colors = c("#53b1dc", "#D9D9D9", "#D0021B")
WCLS <- subset(Cultured_seu, Protocol == 'WLCS')

scHeatmap(WCLS, features = collagen_gene_dict, 
          group.by = c("Annotation", "Condition", "Passage"),
          anno_colors = anno_colors, width = 9, height = 7.5, colors = colors,
          custom_set_colors = collagen_colors,
                    save_path = file.path(save.path, "Culture_WLCS_Collagen_heatmap.pdf")
          )
```
